title: L13 / C11: migration 143 rounding code evidence and limits
public_pr_body:
Adds docs/handover/C11-143-ROUNDING-CODE-EVIDENCE.md with immutable file/line citations: 143 only defines three costing tables/stamp trigger and scoped policies/triggers, not existing financial rounding functions or the protected costing algorithm. Shared lib/money.ts blob is byte-identical on the reviewed 143 branch and pinned candidate; 143 is deferred/absent from the six-release candidate.

Avoids an unsupported stronger claim: enabling/changing rates, percentage precision and input pence conversion can change inputs and rounded prices, while the rounding algorithms remain unchanged. Separates ordinary half-away pence from Python-compatible binary64 tie-even costing and the quote handoff; lists actual catalog/parity/golden/runtime checks still required.

Source objects/immutable links/blob identity and exact migration body in release wrapper checked; whitespace passes. Handover embedded. No app/SQL/golden changes or claimed engine/DB pass, main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
